_meta.purpose: Per-site wire-format hints only — how to wrap an already-assembled, model-agnostic prompt for a specific target site. Never put content-quality principles here; those belong in knowledge/.
_meta.sync: Hand-curated from each vendor's own prompting docs. Update only when a vendor's documented structure actually changes, never speculatively.
_meta.keys: Must match the site.id values returned by detector.js's detectSite().

claude.label: Claude
claude.description: Wrap components in XML tags, e.g. <task>...</task><context>...</context><format>...</format>, per Claude's documented prompting guide.
claude.displayHint: Claude's XML-tag prompt structure will be used.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT
chatgpt.description: Use Markdown headers to separate components, e.g. ## Task / ## Context / ## Format.
chatgpt.displayHint: ChatGPT's Markdown-header prompt structure will be used.

gemini.label: Gemini
gemini.description: Use concise Markdown headers or bold labels (Task: / Context: / Format:); Gemini's own guide favors natural, conversational structuring over heavy markup.
gemini.displayHint: Gemini's prompt structure will be used.

grok.label: Grok
grok.description: Use plain labeled sections (Task: / Context: / Format:) without XML or Markdown markup.
grok.displayHint: Grok's prompt structure will be used.

unsupported.label: Unsupported site
unsupported.description: Fall back to knowledge/templates.md's Template 2 skeleton (Role/Task/Context/Format) with plain labeled sections.
unsupported.displayHint: This site isn't recognized. A generic prompt structure will be used instead.

none.label: No active tab
none.description: No target site detected yet; there is nothing to format.
none.displayHint: No active browser tab was found.
